item.title: Hilarious Posts We Found This Week Of People Being Absolute Menaces
item.description: Some people like watching puppy videos when they're in a bad mood. Others enjoy reading about people being absolute menaces on the internet. Enter the r/foundsatan subreddit. Between putting glue next to a milk carton, leaving passive aggressive notes about parking, and setting up a fake dating ad, these folks found creative new ways to antagonize everyone.

item.title: Hilariously Creative Insults We Found This Week That Belong In A Museum
item.description: Anyone can throw around some schoolyard names, but it takes real creativity to come up with a completely original insult. If you're looking for some inspiration - or just want to laugh - then Reddit's r/rareinsults is the place for you. From calling someone old by referencing green bananas to asking about a person's belief in the Teletubbies, these are the most jaw-dropping disses of the week.
